SELECT uc.user_card_id AS user_card_id, uc.member_id AS member_id, uc.card_id AS card_id, c.card_name AS card_name, t.target_performance AS target_performance, COALESCE(s.current_performance_amount, 0) AS current_performance_amount FROM user_card uc JOIN member m ON m.member_id = uc.member_id AND m.member_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN card c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id
JOIN ( SELECT card_id, MIN(min_performance_amount) AS target_performance FROM performance_tier WHERE period_type = 'MONTH' AND min_performance_amount > 0 GROUP BY card_id ) t ON t.card_id = uc.card_id
LEFT JOIN user_card_monthly_state s ON s.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND s.base_year_month = #{baseYearMonth}
LEFT JOIN notification_setting ns ON ns.member_id = uc.member_id
WHERE uc.card_status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(ns.performance_shortage_enabled, 1) = 1
